title: PAD BUTTONS CALLOUT WIDTH, 8PX SCROLLBAR, ONE SETTINGS ROW HEIGHT
why: Critic c-31y: the rebind callout was offset from the table, the scrollbar was a thin sliver, one Settings row was taller than the rest.
now: The pad buttons callout lines up with the table, scrollbars are 8px, and every settings row is the same height.

edits.anchor: #root #keyslist, #root #setlist{ padding-bottom:var(--sp-5); -webkit-mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--ui-void) calc(100% - var(--sp-5)), transparent); mask-image:linear-gradient(to bottom, var(--ui-void) calc(100% - var(--sp-5)), transparent); }
